requirements.quote:
The "supported_versions" ClientHello extension can be used to
      negotiate the version of TLS to use, in preference to the
      legacy_version field of the ClientHello.
requirements.condition: when a ClientHello contains the supported_versions extension
requirements.required_behavior: use supported_versions to negotiate the TLS version in preference to ClientHello.legacy_version
requirements.why_checkable: Version selection can be tested with conflicting supported_versions and legacy_version values.

requirements.quote:
The "signature_algorithms_cert" extension allows a client to
      indicate which signature algorithms it can validate in X.509
      certificates.
requirements.condition: when a client sends the signature_algorithms_cert extension
requirements.required_behavior: encode the signature algorithms that the client can validate in X.509 certificates
requirements.why_checkable: Extension construction and certificate-selection behavior can be compared with the client's validation capabilities.
